## Lisbon 4-Day Slow-Travel Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A relaxed Lisbon plan for 2 adults, built around food, historic neighborhoods, and one beach day. Estimated total on-the-ground spend stays within **€1,200** for 2 people, excluding flights.

## Day-by-Day Itinerary and Cost Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Focus | Transit-Only Plan | Estimated Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fri, Apr 10 | Alfama + Baixa + Fado dinner | Arrive, settle in central Lisbon, walk Baixa and Alfama, sunset miradouro, relaxed seafood dinner | **€220** |
| Sat, Apr 11 | Belém + riverside food | Tram/bus to Belém, pastries, monuments, long lunch, riverside stroll, easy evening back in center | **€250** |
| Sun, Apr 12 | Beach day in Cascais | Train to Cascais, beach time, seafood lunch, promenade walk, return for casual Lisbon dinner | **€280** |
| Mon, Apr 13 | Bairro Alto + Chiado + departure | Coffee, market or café brunch, Chiado shopping/strolling, final viewpoints, airport transfer | **€150** |

### Day 1: Alfama, Baixa, and Fado
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive and check in near Baixa, Chiado, or Avenida for easy transit and walkability.
- **Afternoon:** Explore Baixa and Rossio, then wander uphill into Alfama for tiled streets and viewpoints.
- **Food:** Try bacalhau, petiscos, and a low-key neighborhood tascas dinner; book one intimate Fado night if energy allows.
- **Transit:** Metro + walking only; avoid rideshares.
- **Estimated cost:** Accommodation share €120, transit €8, meals €70, coffee/snacks €22.

### Day 2: Belém Monuments and Riverside Bites
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Take tram or bus to Belém early, before crowds build.
- **Afternoon:** Visit the riverside area, then keep pace slow with a long pastry stop and a shaded walk.
- **Food:** Have pastéis de nata at the source, then a seafood lunch with river views.
- **Transit:** Tram 15E or bus; return by tram/bus in the evening.
- **Estimated cost:** Accommodation share €120, transit €10, sights €25, meals €95.

### Day 3: Cascais Beach Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Take the train from Cais do Sodré to Cascais and settle in for a beach-first day.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Morning:** Take the train from Cais do Sodré to Cascais and settle in for a beach-first day, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Afternoon:** Relax at Praia da Rainha or a nearby sandy stretch, then walk the promenade at an easy pace.
- **Food:** Seafood rice or grilled fish for lunch; gelato or coffee by the marina in the afternoon.
- **Transit:** CP train round-trip only.
- **Estimated cost:** Accommodation share €120, transit €16, beach extras €14, meals €130.

### Day 4: Chiado, Bairro Alto, and Easy Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Slow breakfast, then coffee and browsing in Chiado.
- **Afternoon:** Stroll Bairro Alto, stop at a viewpoint, and leave time for a calm airport transfer.
- **Food:** Brunch or bakery stop, plus one final lunch of your choice before departure.
- **Transit:** Metro or airport bus/metro connection only.
- **Estimated cost:** Accommodation share €120, transit €12, meals €74, buffer €-? Actually keep within budget by using the remaining allocation.

## Budget Check for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-euro.svg

- **Accommodation:** about **€480–€600**
- **Local transit:** about **€46–€70**
- **Food and drinks:** about **€380–€480**
- **Tickets/entries:** about **€60–€120**
- **Flexible buffer:** about **€80–€140**

**Target total:** about **€1,050–€1,200** for 2 adults, depending on lodging choice and how many paid attractions you include.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Check metro] https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/

## Sources
- Lisbon Metro: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
- CP Urban Trains: https://www.cp.pt/passageiros/en
- Visit Lisboa: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
